description: For a payment over the agent key's limit: asks the pay account's owner to approve it with their passkey. They get a push on their phone and approve or decline on https://mercatura.network/app/approve/{id}. agent must be the agent of an unexpired rules key of the pay account, or an unexpired spender key of it. Without signature this answers the exact text to sign with the agent key (personal_sign) and sends nothing; with it, the request is made: { id, url, status, expiresAt }. It lives 24 hours. Then poll approval_status: once approved, a transfer is already paid; for x402, retry the request with the payment built from the approved authorization and the owner's signature. Limits: 20 waiting per pay account, 60 requests per agent a day.

kind.description: x402: an API's 402 the agent will pay itself once approved; transfer: Mercatura pays it as soon as the owner approves.

nonce.description: A fresh random bytes32; the payment's EIP-3009 nonce.

payAccount.description: The pay account that would pay.

reason.description: Plain text, at most 200 characters, shown to the human.

resource.description: kind x402: the URL being paid for.

signature.description: Optional: the agent key's EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature over the text this tool answers without it.

to.description: Who is paid: the 402's payTo, or the transfer's recipient.

value.description: USDG units (6 decimals) as an integer string: "12500000" is 12.50 USDG.

name: approval_request
title: Approvals: ask your human to approve a payment
